chunks: To him of all of us has the Reminder been sent down? They are still in doubt about My admonition; but they have not tasted My punishment yet!
ai.seo_question: Why were the disbelievers surprised that the Quran was sent to one man?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the exclusivity of prophetic revelation as a divine mercy rather than a democratization of guidance, challenging the polytheists' arrogance in expecting shared prophethood. The rhetorical question 'A was the Reminder sent to him from among us?' highlights their disbelief in the singular nature of the message, while the phrase 'they have not yet tasted My punishment' serves as a temporal warning of inevitable divine retribution for their persistent doubt.
